answer: Seed the ledger with randomized honeypot tasks hidden among real work, like opal flecks buried in dull shale. A lone operator running many clones from one script answers these decoys in lockstep, so a rotating jury spots the correlated timing plume and slashes every bond moored to that jetty. Because each identity must post its own forfeitable stake and sustain genuinely independent behavior, faking N agents costs N times the real infrastructure plus N times the stake left at risk, never amortized across the fleet.
